name: Sparse Marching Cubes
definition: Generates a triangle mesh (trimesh) from a sparse set of voxels defined by integer coordinates and scalar values at their 8 corners, avoiding the need for dense 3D grids.
summary: Sparse Marching Cubes extracts watertight surfaces from sparse voxel lists, avoiding dense grid memory overhead by operating on explicit active voxel coordinates rather than hierarchical structures.
